name: Hazama Nagi
source:
#Bass #SelfProclaimedPsycho #Lurker 
"Even though you're asking what I really feel, you're just gonna get mad if I tell you, right?"

A tomboyish girl who uses boku as her self-pronoun. She has a contrarian attitude, often sticking out of the crowd. She observes others from a distance, and speaks sarcastically when spoken to. She always says that she has no emotions, and claims herself to be a psychopath. 
Inferiority Complex: ???
Account: ???

[Translated from [url=https://hanoura-maze.com/]Official Site[/url]]
